name: Safe Driving
summary:
Have you ever wondered how you would react behind the wheel in critical situations?
Picture this: you’re driving at night—tired, distracted, or after a few drinks—and suddenly everything changes. Would you be able to stay in control of the vehicle? At Four Players VR, we’ve created a driving simulation in Virtual Reality that allows you to safely and powerfully experience how alcohol, fatigue, and distractions affect your reflexes, attention, and decision-making.
